additions.title: KidsLearn Plus - Ang Mo Kio (Term 1 2027)
additions.description: Help preschool children practise reading and phonics through games and befriending at the Ang Mo Kio placement. The programme schedule runs from 5 December 2026 to 6 March 2027, including preparation; check the required training and session commitment before registering.
additions.eligibility: Volunteers aged 18-35. Check the organiser's training, attendance and role requirements.

additions.title: Garden Keepers - Gardens by the Bay (17 Oct 2026)
additions.description: Maintain outdoor gardens through hands-on gardening on 17 October. This is a fully outdoor, physical activity involving plants, thorns and sap; review the organiser's suitability guidance before signing up.
additions.eligibility: Volunteers aged 15-35 who can participate in outdoor gardening.

additions.title: Sentinel Programme - 2027 Secondary 3 Intake
additions.description: Apply for the digital and cybersecurity development programme starting 9 January 2027. This open intake is for students in Secondary 2 in 2026; selection testing is scheduled for October. Other 2027 intakes do not open until 19 October.
additions.eligibility: Singapore citizens and permanent residents in Secondary 2 in 2026. Selection applies.

additions.title: Sentinel Online Taster Workshops - October and November 2026
additions.description: Preview the Sentinel Programme online. Secondary 4-5 students: 31 October, 2-4pm, register by 17 October. Primary 6 students: 21 November, 2-4pm, register by 7 November. After 17 October, only the Primary 6 workshop remains open. Workshop registration is separate from programme admission.
additions.eligibility: Eligible Singapore citizen or permanent resident students in the stated school cohorts.

additions.title: Lumiere Junior Scholars Essay Contest 2026
additions.description: Write an original English argumentative essay of up to 1,000 words. Free registration closes 30 November; late registration costs US$5. Final essays are due 20 December at 11:59pm Eastern Time. Prizes are tuition reductions for Lumiere programmes, subject to admission, rather than cash awards.
additions.eligibility: Students worldwide in grades 6-8 as of 31 May 2026. An academic referee is required.

additions.title: Duke-UNC CLS Essay Competition 2026
additions.description: Submit an English essay of up to 1,500 words on US-China relations by email using the official instructions. Standard deadline: 15 October, US$15 fee. Late deadline: 9 November, US$30 total fee. Fee waivers are available. Recognition at the 2027 summit does not include travel or accommodation.
additions.eligibility: High school and undergraduate students worldwide; category-specific prompts apply.

additions.title: Planet+ Climate Solutions Challenge 2026-27
additions.description: Teams develop climate solutions through online deliverables, with a Singapore final in March 2027. Registration closes 31 October. Phase 1 costs US$1,500 per team; advancing teams pay an additional US$3,000 for Phase 2. Review travel and other costs before applying.
additions.eligibility: High school and undergraduate students worldwide in teams of 6-10; high school teams need an advisor.

additions.title: COBIS Poetry Competition 2026-27
additions.description: Write a poem exploring the theme If Walls Could Speak. School staff submit selected student entries by midday BST on 9 October. Free for eligible COBIS schools; each school may submit one entry per category.
additions.eligibility: Students at COBIS member and applicant schools worldwide; Key Stage 1-5 categories. School submission required.

additions.title: COBIS Generation:Enterprise 2026-27
additions.description: Develop and pitch a solution to a school, community or global challenge in teams of 2-6. School staff register by midday UK time on 16 October. Paid school entry: standard category fees are GBP180-300, with small-school discounts; review the fee schedule.
additions.eligibility: Students aged 9-18 in participating schools. Registration must be made by school staff, not students or parents.

additions.title: COBIS x DAIGON Esports Competition 2026-27
additions.description: Represent your school in Minecraft Capture the Flag or Rocket League. School registration closes at midday GMT on 30 October. Entry costs US$35 per student. Group matches run November-January; qualified teams reach the February final.
additions.eligibility: COBIS school squads; game-specific year-group brackets apply. Suggested minimum age is 8. School-led registration.

additions.title: COBIS Research Skills Competition 2026-27
additions.description: Develop research skills and submit an independent report on an appropriate topic of your choice. Registration closes at midday GMT on 19 November; reports are submitted from 11 January to 22 February 2027. Entry costs GBP70 per student.
additions.eligibility: Students in Years 10-13 at participating schools; school registration and programme requirements apply.

additions.title: Debate Mate x COBIS Virtual Debating Competition 2027
additions.description: Compete in online school-team debates from 29-31 January 2027. Register by midday GMT on 30 September; places are limited. Entry costs GBP325 per team including VAT, invoiced to schools. Beginners are welcome.
additions.eligibility: COBIS member and applicant school students aged 14+, Years 9-12 or equivalent. Schools enter their teams.

additions.title: COBIS Changemakers Competition 2026-27
additions.description: Plan and deliver a community or environmental project, then share its impact in a five-minute video. School registration is open until midday GMT on 14 December; video submissions run 26 February-12 March 2027. Free for eligible COBIS schools.
additions.eligibility: Years 1-13 at COBIS member and applicant schools. Teams of up to 10; one selected entry per school.
